title: feat: improve model catalog navigation and MCP UI
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds top-level Models, Agents, and MCP navigation with matching icons and stable quantity counts; model categories contain only models and search stays within the active slice.
- Adds a Community toggle enabled by default that preserves its state across tabs; Agents remains visibly on and disabled, with a compact privacy disclosure covering providers and configured fallbacks.
- Redesigns MCP cards to match model pricing, typography, copy interactions, and responsive two-column layout; removes redundant Built-in and billing labels.
- Aligns MCP price values and units, clips model-ledger separators correctly, and removes repeated values from copy tooltips.
- Simplifies sorting by removing Oldest and labeling newest-first catalog order as Date added.

Tests: `npm run build:frontend`; `npx tsc --noEmit`; `npx biome check`; `npx vitest run test/model-categories.test.ts test/model-sort.test.ts`.

gist.headline: The catalog found its shelves
gist.blurb: The model catalog grew proper rooms for Models, Agents, and MCP. Fewer repeated labels, sturdier counts, and much less rummaging through the same drawer.
gist.summary: Redesigned the catalog with top-level Models, Agents, and MCP tabs, stable item counts, active-slice search, a persistent Community toggle, refreshed responsive MCP cards, and a simplified newest-first “Date added” sort.
gist.impact: People browsing models and MCP servers can now stay within the catalog section they chose, compare MCP pricing more clearly, and keep their Community preference while moving between tabs.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the catalog as a cozy garden library with three clearly labeled shelves—Models, Agents, and MCP—each holding glowing seed packets or tiny tools. Polli, wearing a librarian visor, guides the eager CRT Monitor Robot toward the MCP shelf while code-plants and flowers grow around a neat two-column display; a small Community toggle is visibly switched on.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink rectangular blush, light blue wings, and a tiny librarian visor, organizing a warm garden library with three pixel shelves labeled “MODELS”, “AGENTS”, and “MCP”; a cheerful CRT monitor robot points at neatly aligned MCP tool cards while code-plants bloom beside them and a small “COMMUNITY: ON” toggle glows. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic but beautiful.
